about.title: About
about.p1: UXNTWWW.io is a site with files and utilities for Windows. Here I publish small tools for system cleaning, text editing, and other tasks.
about.p2: All files are my own tools that I develop and maintain. Main projects:
about.li1: UXNTWWW SYSTEM TOOLKIT (PCCleaner) — a system cleaning tool.
about.li2: UXWEditor Free — an editor for .uxw and other text formats.
about.p3: All files are checked before publishing. Downloads are available both from the site and via GitHub Releases — where you can see the source code and history.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Antivirus flags the file. What to do?
faq.a1: It's a false positive — the tools work with system folders (Temp, DNS, cache), so antiviruses sometimes react. All files are verified, sources are on GitHub. You can add it to exclusions.
faq.a2: The programs are portable — no installation required. Download, extract (if .zip), run. Simpler and leaves no traces in the system.
faq.q3: How to update to a new version?
faq.a3: The tools check for updates themselves. You can also manually download a new version from the main page or GitHub Releases.
faq.a4: Main support is Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit). On Windows 7 some features may not work correctly.
faq.a5: Yes, the programs are free. The only condition — don't claim them as your own and don't sell them.
